items.body: Google DeepMind 11 月 18 日发布 Gemini 4 Neon，Gemini 4 家族的第四款模型（七周内第四款），定位在 Carbon（最难的长程任务）与 Hydrogen（日常快任务）之间：Artificial Analysis 智力指数 xhigh 档 61 分排第三，仅次于更大的慢模型；编码 agent 指数第一（58.6）；Vals 指数第二（70.9%）；Terminal-Bench 4.1 得 65.2%。定价 $3/$15 每百万 tokens，缓存输入 $0.15，1M 上下文；默认 high 档每任务成本比 Carbon 低 32%。HN 主帖 783 分/645 评；X 上 Artificial Analysis（1,168 次互动）、Cursor、François Chollet、Sundar Pichai 等多账号热议；Cursor 已接入，CursorBench 4.1 得 63.7%（高于 Hydrogen 的 57.3%）；GitHub Copilot、Vercel AI Gateway 同步上线。数字来自 Google 官方博客与 Artificial Analysis、Vals、Arena 的独立指数。

en.action: Write a tweet, leading with 'fourth model in seven weeks + #1 on the coding agent index + $3/$15 pricing'.
en.body: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Neon on November 18, the fourth model in the Gemini 4 family (the fourth in seven weeks), sitting between Carbon (hardest long-horizon tasks) and Hydrogen (fast everyday tasks): 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at xhigh, ranking #3 overall behind larger, slower models; #1 on the Coding Agent Index (58.6); #2 on the Vals Index (70.9%); 65.2% on Terminal-Bench 4.1. Priced at $3/$15 per million tokens with cached input at $0.15 and a 1M-token context window; at its default high setting it costs 32% less per task than Carbon. The HN thread reached 783 points / 645 comments; on X, Artificial Analysis (1,168 interactions), Cursor, François Chollet, Sundar Pichai and others piled in. Cursor has already shipped it, scoring 63.7% on CursorBench 4.1 (above Hydrogen's 57.3%); GitHub Copilot and Vercel AI Gateway added it the same day. Figures come from Google's official blog and the independent Artificial Analysis, Vals and Arena indexes.
en.title: Gemini 4 Neon is out: #3 on the AA Intelligence Index at 61, $3/$15 pricing, gunning for Opus 5.5

en.body: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share on November 18, above its $70–$78 target range. items.action: 仅记录（社会观察：AI 强制捆绑首次遭遇机构级反弹）。
items.body: 《纽约时报》11 月 18 日报道：全美最大的三个学区——纽约、洛杉矶、芝加哥（共 157 万学生）正在考虑弃用 Google Search。起因是 Google 规定：从 2027 年起，学校关掉 Gemini 相关功能就同时失去 Search 访问权，称两者“深度整合”、无法提供无 AI 的搜索版本。纽约市学校校长 Kamar H. Samuels 表态：“如果 Google 不重新考虑立场，我们将探索其他搜索选项”；芝加哥公立学校亦称将寻找其他方案；洛杉矶已关掉学生的 AI Overviews，其 CIO 称换默认搜索引擎“一夜之间”就能完成。备选为 DuckDuckGo 与微软 Bing，两者都允许关掉 AI 生成答案。The Verge 同日跟进。

en.action: Just record it (social observation: forced AI bundling meets its first institutional pushback).
en.body: The New York Times reported on November 18 that the three largest school districts in the US — New York City, Los Angeles and Chicago (1.57 million students combined) — are considering dropping Google Search. The trigger is Google's rule that, from 2027, schools that switch off Gemini features will also lose Search access, because the two are 'deeply integrated' and no AI-free version of Search can be offered. New York City schools chancellor Kamar H. Samuels said: 'If Google doesn't reconsider their position, we will explore other search options.' Chicago Public Schools said it would look for other solutions; Los Angeles has already switched off AI Overviews for students, and its CIO said changing the default search engine could be done 'literally overnight'. The alternatives under discussion are DuckDuckGo and Microsoft's Bing, both of which let users switch off AI-generated answers. The Verge followed up the same day.
en.title: Three giant school districts weigh dropping Google Search: turn off Gemini, lose Search too

items.action: 仅记录（社会观察：AI 重组首次以“买断换选择权”的形式摊牌）。
items.body: 微软 CEO 纳德拉 11 月 18 日在 DealBook Summit 上解释：10 月向 6 万名员工提供自愿离职买断，目的不是用 AI 替代员工（尤其不是替代软件工程师），而是配合 AI 重组——未来每位员工的工作都将围绕使用 AI 展开，角色转向“管理 agent”而非亲自执行任务；买断是给员工选择权，“至少让每个人都觉得自己能掌控选择”。微软未公布有多少人接受买断。单源 TechCrunch。

en.action: Just record it (social observation: the AI reorg goes public as 'a buyout in exchange for a choice').
en.body: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explained at the DealBook Summit on November 18 that the voluntary buyouts offered to 60,000 employees in October were not about replacing workers with AI — least of all software engineers — but about an AI reorg: every employee's job will soon revolve around using AI, with roles shifting to 'managing agents' rather than doing the work directly. The buyout was meant to give employees a choice: 'to make sure that at least everyone felt like they had agency in making choices.' Microsoft has not said how many accepted. Single source: TechCrunch.
en.title: Nadella on why he offered 60,000 Microsoft staff buyouts: not AI layoffs — everyone becomes an agent manager

ja.action: 記録のみ（社会観察：AI再編が「選択権と引き換えの買収」という形で公になった）。
ja.body: MicrosoftのSatya Nadella CEOは11月18日、DealBook Summitで次のように説明した。10月に6万人の従業員に提示した自発的退職の買収は、AIで従業員を置き換えるためではなく（とりわけソフトウェアエンジニアの置き換えではなく）、AI再編のためだ。今後すべての従業員の仕事はAIの利用を中心に回り、役割は作業を直接行うことから「エージェントを管理すること」へ移る。買収は従業員に選択肢を与えるためのもので、「少なくとも誰もが選択について主体性を持っていると感じられるようにするため」だという。何人が受け入れたかはMicrosoftは公表していない。単独の情報源はTechCrunch。
